title: 开始阅读最后更新：2026-07-25 21:35:35 最新章节：第287章 一个不可能出现的人
slug: 大楚第一探花开局卧底女魔头
content_zh:
宋牧驰望着周围陌生的环境，一时间有些懵逼。
连续996当了几个月牛马，好不容易有半天假却被老板喊去陪客户，结果去商喝个酒就给干牢里来了？
这是在拍古装短剧？
忽然间无数信息涌入脑海，他整个人都傻了，好像……穿越了？
他在这个世界也叫宋牧驰，是楚国已故首辅宋之正的四公子。
明明含着金钥匙长大，可依然难逃当牛马的命。
因为他有一个特殊体质——先天牛马圣体！
哪怕这是个妖魔遍地的修行世界，先天圣体也是极罕见的体质，每一位都是天之骄子。
唯独先天牛马圣体例外，因为要激活必须认某人为主，之后每一分修为都要上交主人九成。
在修行界是最好的炉-鼎体质！
于是他果断弃武从文，殿试中被点为探花，本以为可以走儒道体系，却被京中高人发现了其特殊体质。
宫中有位贵人想跟他签订契约，自然被他拒绝了。
为了避祸，他从此流连青楼，深受各地花魁喜爱，被人戏称为大楚第一探花。
因修行者未入八品真阳境，先破了元阳之身，注定一生无法寸进，宫中贵人只好作罢。
本来当个纨绔子弟也不错，可惜宋之正过世后，昔日政敌忽然发难，整个宋家都被抄家入狱。
绝境之下，这位四公子按照不久前奇遇得到的诡异残卷，在牢中举行了一场认自己为主的神秘仪式，想激活圣体来拯救家人。
结果弄得魂飞魄散，反倒把地球上的他给召唤过来了。
“同病相怜啊。”宋牧驰感慨他这牛马的一生，忽然心中一动，“既然仪式完成了，这牛马圣体到底能不能用？”
他按照记忆中的法门引动经脉中的气血之力。
“有戏！”宋牧驰心中一喜。

不过很快便愣住了，刚刚积攒下来的气血之力眨眼间只剩下了一成。
“果然是九成修为上交？坑爹啊！”宋牧驰集中全部精神，死死追踪被吸走的九成气血之力究竟去了哪里。
只见“丹田”上空浮着一个跟他一模一样的小人打坐。
正是被它吸收了！
难道这玩意就是他的主人，每次修炼上供九成给它？
正又惊又怒之际，忽然一种奇怪的联系传来——他和小人竟然心意相通！
我成了自己的主人？
下一瞬消失的九成气血之力，从那小人反哺回身体的四肢百骸，甚至比之前更加精纯！
吃的是草，挤出的是奶？
这哪还是什么废体！
异变再生。
他“看”到丹田的虚无处，忽然游弋出一条灵动的、半透明的小鱼。
心念一动，那小人便伸出手朝小鱼抓去。
【异象·摸鱼】
“一个合格的牛马怎能不会摸鱼？
首先要有看破一切虚妄的眼力才能选择最合适的摸鱼时机。”
每个先天圣体都会在体内觉醒一个异象，这个异象就是他们碾压同龄人的关键。
先天牛马圣体成功激活了？
不过我这个异象怎么有些不正经。
正疑惑间，忽然注意到窗户那里坐着一个娇艳妩媚的少女，红裙仿佛燃烧的晚霞一般，双脚轻轻摇曳，脚踝上细细的银链随着摆动闪烁着微光。

银链虽白，可是和惊鸿一现的肌肤比起来，还是黯然失色。
content_en:
Song Muchi looked at the unfamiliar environment around him, feeling a little confused for a moment.
After working as a 996 for several months, I finally got half a day off, but my boss called me to accompany a client, and then I went to a business to have a drink and ended up in jail?
Is this a costume short drama?
Suddenly, countless information poured into his mind, and he was dumbfounded, as if... traveling through time?
He is also called Song Muchi in this world, and he was the fourth son of Song Zhizheng, the late chief minister of the Chu Kingdom.
Although he grew up with a golden key in his mouth, he still couldn't escape the fate of being a cow and a horse.
Because he has a special physique - the innate ox-horse holy body!
Even if this is a world of cultivation filled with demons and monsters, the innate holy body is an extremely rare physique, and everyone is a proud son of heaven.
The only exception is the Innate Ox-Horse Sacred Body, because in order to be activated, one must recognize someone as the master, and after that, 90% of every point of cultivation must be handed over to the owner.
It is the best furnace-ding physique in the world of spiritual practice!
So he decisively gave up martial arts and followed literature. He was selected as the top pick in the palace examination. He thought he could follow the Confucian and Taoist system, but his special physique was discovered by the masters in Beijing.
A nobleman in the palace wanted to sign a contract with him, but he naturally refused.
In order to avoid trouble, he stayed in brothels from then on, and was deeply loved by courtesans from all over the country. He was jokingly called the number one prostitute in Chu.
Because the practitioner has broken the Yuanyang body before entering the eighth-grade True Yang realm, he is doomed to be unable to advance even an inch in his life, so the nobles in the palace had no choice but to give up.
Originally, it was not bad to be a dandy, but unfortunately after Song Zhizheng passed away, his former political enemies suddenly attacked him, and the entire Song family was confiscated and imprisoned.
In a desperate situation, the fourth son held a mysterious ceremony in prison to recognize himself as the master based on the strange fragments he had encountered recently, hoping to activate the Holy Body to save his family.
As a result, he was so shaken that he was summoned from the earth.
"We share the same suffering." Song Muchi lamented the life of his cow and horse, and suddenly his heart moved, "Now that the ceremony is completed, can this cow and horse's holy body be used?"
He activated the power of Qi and blood in the meridians according to the method in his memory.
"There's something going on!" Song Muchi was delighted.
But he soon froze, and in the blink of an eye, only 10% of the energy and blood power he had just accumulated was left.
"Sure enough, he turned in 90% of his cultivation level? What a rip-off!" Song Muchi concentrated all his energy on tracking down where the 90% of the energy and blood that had been sucked away went.
I saw a little man who looked exactly like him meditating floating in the sky above the "Dan Tian".
Just be absorbed by it!
Could it be that this thing is his master, and he gives 90% to it every time he practices?
Just when he was shocked and angry, a strange connection suddenly came - he and the villain actually had the same mind!
Have I become my own master?
Ninety percent of the energy and blood that disappeared in the next moment was fed back to the body from the villain, and the limbs and bones were even purer than before!
What you eat is grass and what you squeeze out is milk?
What kind of waste is this?
Mutation regeneration.
He "saw" the void in his Dantian, and suddenly a small, smart, translucent fish swam out.
With a thought in his mind, the little man stretched out his hand to catch the little fish.
[Vision·Fishing]
“How can a qualified cow and horse not know how to fish?
First of all, you must have the vision to see through all illusions in order to choose the most suitable time to fish. "
Every innate holy body will awaken a vision in the body, and this vision is the key to crushing their peers.
The innate cow-horse holy body was successfully activated?
But why is this vision of mine a bit unorthodox?
While he was wondering, he suddenly noticed a charming girl sitting by the window. Her red dress was like a burning sunset, her feet were swaying gently, and the thin silver chains on her ankles were shimmering as they swayed.
Although the silver chain is white, it still pales in comparison to the sudden appearance of the skin.
